title: Sukha Singh Chooses Martyrdom Against Abdali

blocks.text: As news spreads that Singhs are approaching, Ahmad Shah’s camp is jolted into alert preparation and watches the horizon for the attack. The page makes the numerical imbalance unmistakable, because Sukha Singh and his companions are moving against a force far larger than their own.

What matters most is Sukha Singh’s moral choice under those odds. He openly chooses martyrdom over retreat, telling his companions that honor is worth more than survival purchased by withdrawal in the face of Abdali.
The companions answer in the same spirit and refuse to desert him. Their decision turns a daring raid into a consciously shared act of sacrifice rather than a reckless impulse by one leader alone.
